cohort: The study included 1000 antenatal women with at least one live child.
finding: Younger mothers (aged 20-25 years) were significantly less likely to initiate breastfeeding early, and maternal literacy was a key determinant, with illiterate women having lower awareness about early initiation.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery significantly influenced breastfeeding practices.
cross-section timing: The study was conducted among antenatal women.
